scope: PS4/PS5 host connection checks, exact download-copy routing and uncertain-transfer recovery
features: Fixed bounded read-only checks for loader/manager, downloader queue and standard native file-manager pages, with separate evidence summaries.
Address and pairing generations discard stale replies, including A-to-B-to-A edits and older same-address responses.
Download-a-copy-on-Load uses the same exact console file ID and destination synchronously during the original click; completion never retargets or duplicates it.
Post-dispatch lost acknowledgements, timeouts, server5xx and socket failures report uncertain; preflight failures remain non-executing.
Per-address uncertain warnings survive reload, lock Load until explicit review/clear and never trigger retries; stale paired helpers are blocked before copying or sending.
Clarified ezRemote Server downloader vs ezRemote Client file-manager setup and native installation links.
limits: Console hardware transfers, installation and execution remain untested. No downloaded payload or exploit was executed.
A readable queue does not verify companion HTML installation or writable storage; a file-manager page response does not verify its identity or file operations.
No raw TCP9020/9021 readiness probes. The PS4 bootstrap remains a separate manual stage; no unverified GoldHEN binary/ABI mapping was enabled.
No commit, publication or deployment performed.
preservation: All pinned payload/game/firmware data,95 ready downloads,23 executable transport mappings,native receiver11 and prior sender/source/build snapshots preserved.
